name: portalscript
description: Live transcription and interview copilot for macOS
author: Palol Zaman

scripts.ensure:helper: (test native/AudioCaptureHelper -nt native/AudioCaptureHelper.swift && test native/AudioCaptureHelper -nt native/Info.plist) || npm run build:swift
scripts.ensure:extractor: test native/DocTextExtractor -nt native/DocTextExtractor.swift || npm run build:extractor
scripts.start: npm run ensure:helper && npm run ensure:extractor && npm run build:renderer && electron .
scripts.dev: npm run build:native && npm run build:renderer && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build:native && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac --publish never
